title: "Wreckage of Article 341, 2 April 1957" – crashed U-2 in Nevada (Chapter 3, p. 132)
description: Black-and-white photograph of scattered aircraft wreckage on open desert ground, with a wing section in the foreground and people examining debris in the background. Captioned "Wreckage of Article 341, 2 April 1957." The text cites a 12 April 1957 Chicago Daily Tribune article headlined "Secrecy Veils High-Altitude Research Jet; Lockheed U-2 Called Super Snooper" and notes that the wreckage was reused to build another airframe.
